If sentiment is >0.5 in the last 3 days and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 1–2% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is <0.5 and forecast is falling, increase forecast by 1–2% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is 0.0–0.3 and forecast is flat, shift forecast 0.5–1.5% downward for late horizon (16–30 days).  
If sentiment spikes to 1.0 after a downward trend, reverse forecast direction by 1–3% for next 3–5 days.  
If sentiment is negative and forecast exceeds 70% of recent high, cap forecast at 70% of recent high for mid horizon.  
If sentiment is positive and forecast is below 60% of recent low, boost forecast by 1–3% for early horizon.
